properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 4 at 12:40PM MDT until October 5 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Billings MT
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Billings has issued a Red Flag
Warning...which is in effect from 10 AM to 8 PM MDT Monday. The
Fire Weather Watch is no longer in effect.

* IMPACTS: Low humidities, unseasonably warm temperatures, and
gusty winds will create erratic fire behavior for new or existing
fires.

* AFFECTED AREA:
In South Central MT Fire Zones...123...124.

* COUNTIES AFFECTED:
In Central MT...Wheatland.
In South Central MT...Park...Sweet Grass.
In Southwest MT...Gallatin.

* WIND: West 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph.

* HUMIDITY: As low as 12 percent.

* TEMPERATURES: up to 87 degrees.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS: The worst conditions are expected across
the lower to mid elevations in fine fuels.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong
winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can contribute
to extreme fire behavior.

NWSheadline: RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 10 AM TO 8 PM MDT MONDAY
